I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm the update: Gate 35 is now his dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Juniper project. I also told him I'll keep it private to that DM.

I don't have a dedicated memory store, so I told him plainly that the note is kept in our DM history and that's where I'll look it up later. He said no action was needed, so I didn't take any other action.
